datahub_mcp_url.title: DataHub MCP URL
datahub_mcp_url.description: Your DataHub tenant's MCP endpoint: an https URL ending in /mcp, such as https://your-company.acryl.io/mcp. Use https://mcp.datahub.com/mcp to connect through the shared DataHub MCP gateway instead.
